Title: Create a new appointment reservation
Preconditions: User has a valid shop ID and appointment request details
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shops/{shopId}/appointments with a valid AppointmentReq payload in the request body. 2. Verify the response status code is 200 and the response body contains the created appointment reservation details.

Test Data: {"customerName": "John Doe", "customerPhone": "1234567890", "serviceId": 1, "workerId": 1, "appointmentDate": "2024-09-16"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200 and the response body contains the created appointment reservation details, including the appointment ID, customer name, customer phone, service ID, worker ID, and appointment date.
